name: taskapp
description: Application web de gestion de tâches (API Express + SPA React)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @taskapp/shared" "npm run dev -w @taskapp/api" "npm run dev -w @taskapp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @taskapp/web && npm run build -w @taskapp/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @taskapp/shared && npm run test:unit -w @taskapp/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @taskapp/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage -w @taskapp/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @taskapp/e2e
